kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/chatbot -- python -c 'import urllib.request; print(urllib.request.urlopen("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo/3.1.0/src/accounting/Consumer.cs").read().decode())'

kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/chatbot -- python -c 'import urllib.request; [print(u,urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=10).status) for u in ["http://chatbot:7860/","http://frontend-proxy:8080/","http://frontend-proxy:8080/chatbot/"]]'
kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/load-generator -- sed -n '210,250p' locustfile.py; kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/agent -- sh -c 'grep -R -n "MCP_ENABLED" src'

kubectl -n otel-demo get prometheusrule otel-demo-alerting-rules -o json > /tmp/otel-rules-before.json; kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/chatbot -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://mcp:8011/mcp",data=json.dumps({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"<time>","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"incident-verification","version":"1"}}}).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json, text/event-stream"})); print(r)'

kubectl -n otel-demo patch prometheusrule otel-demo-alerting-rules --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/groups/2/rules/0/expr","value":"histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name!~\"flagd|load-generator|frontend*\",namespace=\"otel-demo\",span_name!=\"order-consumed\"}[2m]))) > 1500"},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/groups/2/rules/0/annotations/description","value":"Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is above 1500ms (current: {{ $value }}ms)"},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/groups/4/rules/0/expr","value":"sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name!~\"flagd|load-generator|chatbot|mcp\",status_code=~\"STATUS_CODE_UNSET|STATUS_CODE_OK\",namespace=\"otel-demo\"}[5m])) == 0"}]'

kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/chatbot -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; req=urllib.request.Request("http://mcp:8011/mcp",data=json.dumps({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"<time>","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"incident-verification","version":"1"}}}).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json, text/event-stream"}); r=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10); print(r.status,r.read().decode())'

kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/chatbot -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus:9090/prometheus/api/v1/alerts")); print(json.dumps([a for a in d["data"]["alerts"] if a["labels"].get("namespace")=="otel-demo"],indent=2))'
agent.summary:
The three reported alerts were false positives: accounting’s span included Kafka idle waiting, chatbot had no generated traffic, and MCP was disabled in the agent configuration.

I corrected the alert rules and latency units. All three alerts cleared. Storefront, chatbot, and MCP checks succeeded; accounting continues processing orders normally.
